content: Hello, I would like to place a delivery order, please.
Welcome to Karachi Kitchen! What would you like to order today?
I would like to order two chicken biryanis and one raita for delivery. Are they available, and how much do they cost?
Chicken biryani is actually sold out today, but we have raita for one hundred fifty rupees.
Ah, chicken biryani is sold out. Do you have chicken karahi or chicken pulao instead?
Both chicken karahi and chicken pulao are sold out today as well, but we do have our special prawn biryani for thirteen hundred rupees.
No seafood for me, thank you. Do you have any other chicken dishes available?
No, all our other chicken dishes are sold out today.
Ah, I see. Since you don't have any chicken biryani, karahi, or pulao, and I cannot have seafood or beef, I won't be able to place an order today. Thank you anyway, goodbye!
